rules.description: Zakon o radu čl. 77(1): at least four weeks annual leave for each calendar year

source.title: Hrvatski sabor: Odluka o nedavanju vjerodostojnog tumačenja članka 77. stavka 1. Zakona o radu (NN 46/2023)

versions.notes: Sabor decision NN 46/2023 quoting Art. 77(1): "pravo na godišnji odmor ima radnik za svaku kalendarsku godinu u trajanju od najmanje četiri tjedna". Minors and workers in harmful conditions: at least five weeks (not modelled). Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).
